teachingQuestion: How does an investigation preserve facts without weakening authority or evidence integrity?
focalInsight: Authority, collection, custody, analysis, and reporting must remain linked and attributable.
title: Investigation evidence chain
caption: Each handoff preserves scope, integrity, and accountability.
altSummary: An investigation moves from authority and scope through preservation, collection, custody recording, and reproducible analysis and reporting.
textFallback: Confirm authority and scope before preserving the scene. Collect volatile and persistent evidence with validated methods, record every custody transfer and action, analyze working copies where practical, and report findings with limits and provenance.
